# Claude API reference (Anthropic)

Up-to-date guidance for building apps on the Claude API and Anthropic SDKs.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/skills/main/skills/claude-api/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/claude-api-reference-anthropic-b5ea3e3a

Gives Claude a current reference for the Claude API so it doesn't rely on stale training data: model IDs, pricing, streaming, tool use, prompt caching, thinking settings, MCP and agent patterns. It triggers whenever code or a question involves Claude or Anthropic, or an LLM task where no other provider is named. Per-language folders cover Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, C#, Ruby, PHP and curl. It is large, and model details reflect the date it was last refreshed.

**Try asking:**
- "Add streaming and prompt caching to my Claude chatbot in Python"
- "Which Claude model should I use for a cheap classification job?"
- "Migrate this code from the old completions API to Messages"

**Source:** [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/HEAD/skills/claude-api) · Apache-2.0 · by Anthropic
